answer: Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check. Three words, three keepers: the saffron belongs to the toy shop, the sonnet to the paint pot, the ledge to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Grape carrier sweet muscat warrant racked in the fermenting room is that proof, written out as each sweet muscat is a year of cellar logs in the wine ledger. Clean grading for 13 days is the only road to a refund, so the farm's 113730 POA earns nothing in the meantime.
